I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. The ticket number is PD-4821.

Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import file was attached to that ticket. Tobias is in that channel, so he could have seen it himself. I also passed on Hollis's warning from the same message: the import file labels the doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02.

There's a separate ticket, SUP-5102, for Marrow Agrisupply's new-store onboarding. It isn't the Eastbank import ticket, so I didn't bring it up.

One slip: my reply calls Hollis "he", and I don't actually know Hollis's pronouns.
